connector.name: MTG MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Magic: The Gathering card search, combo lookup, draft analytics, and Commander tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mtg-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the j4th account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: MTG_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging level — DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR

env.name: MTG_MCP_ENABLE_EDHREC
env.description: Enable EDHREC commander metagame backend (uses undocumented endpoints)

env.name: MTG_MCP_ENABLE_BULK_DATA
env.description: Enable Scryfall Oracle Cards bulk data for rate-limit-free lookups (~30 MB download)

env.name: MTG_MCP_SCRYFALL_RATE_LIMIT_MS
env.description: Minimum delay between Scryfall API calls in milliseconds

env.name: MTG_MCP_BULK_DATA_REFRESH_HOURS
env.description: Hours between Scryfall bulk data refreshes

env.name: MTG_MCP_ENABLE_RULES
env.description: Enable Comprehensive Rules engine for rules lookup and keyword tools

env.name: MTG_MCP_DISABLE_CACHE
env.description: Disable in-memory TTL caching (useful for testing)

env.name: MTG_MCP_ENABLE_MOXFIELD
env.description: Enable Moxfield deck search and import backend (reverse-engineered API)

env.name: MTG_MCP_ENABLE_MTGGOLDFISH
env.description: Enable MTGGoldfish metagame data backend (HTML scraping)
